subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Reorder Point Method
description: A quick, practical guide to Reorder Point Method.

hook.text: When stock drops to 50 units, the system automatically orders 200 more. No human involved. No stockout.

buildup.text: The reorder point (ROP) triggers a new order when inventory falls to a preset level. It's simple and automatic.

discovery.text: ROP = (average daily demand × lead time) + safety stock. It accounts for both usage rate and delivery time.

twist.text: ROP assumes stable demand. If demand spikes suddenly, the reorder triggers too late and you stock out.

climax.text: Dynamic ROP systems adjust the trigger based on recent demand patterns and lead time changes.

punchline.text: Set the trigger right and inventory manages itself.

quiz.question: What triggers a new order in the reorder point method?
options: Stock falling to a preset level
